title: FoxDarkMagic
description: Thaumcraft mod automation. New alchemical furnace and node creation
body:
# **FoxDarkMagic** *** ## This mod is designed for GTNH version of mods!
**FoxDarkMagic - expands your magical and automation capabilities by adding powerful tools and systems designed for efficiency, scaling, and convenience ⚡**
 ## ⚡ What does this mod add? 🔌 **Accelerated Essentia Import/Export Buses** Move essentia faster than ever before and eliminate bottlenecks in your automation systems. 🔥 **High-Speed Furnace** Smelt large amounts of items quickly and efficiently — perfect for mass processing. 🌌 **Aura Infusion Block** Consumes essentia and automatically fills aura nodes, keeping your magical network stable and powered. 📚 **Special Books** * The Book of knowledge gives all the researches * The Book of Cleaning reduces warp to 0. 🏭 **Full Automation Systems** Automate key magical processes with ease: * Crucible * Infusion Matrix * Arcane Workbench ⚙️ **Matrix Stabilizer** Improve infusion stability and reduce risks during crafting. ### 😏 Why use this mod? ✔️ Removes tedious manual work ✔️ Speeds up magical progression ✔️ Perfect for automation-focused players ✔️ Makes complex systems simple and efficient ## ⚠️ Requirements * Minecraft **1.7.10 (Forge)** * Thaumcraft 4 * AppliedEnergestics 2 ## 🌐 Join the Community 💬 Got questions? Ideas? Found a bug? Join our Discord and be part of the project! 👉 **Discord:** **[\-2 Circle of Hell](https://discord.gg/Td59WbfApr)**
